title: Agnus (Renaldo, Missa Sine nomine (Bologna Q19))
desc: Renaldo, Missa Sine nomine (Bologna Q19), Agnus. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Source: Bologna Q19. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
